## CEO overview

- **What is changing:** Firstmate gains a daily system-map drift check that compares declared automations, live registry outcomes, checked-in workflow exports, host inventory, and live n8n workflows in one redacted report, plus a sourced Engineering Radar changed-this-week section.
- **Why it matters:** Without a single daily score, automation reality could drift from declarations and repository exports without surfacing until something breaks.
- **Customer or business impact:** Operators get one pass-or-fail daily map, watcher notifications only when the score changes, and weekly engineering context in the same report without exposing credentials.
- **Risk and rollout:** The feature reuses existing n8n comparison and registry infrastructure rather than adding a parallel scheduler; bounded watcher budgets and daily sweep gating limit load. One live scenario (registry HTTP without operator credentials) remains untested in CI.

## What changed technically

- Added `bin/fm-system-map.sh` with `check`, `score`, `arm`, and `disarm` commands that build a redacted drift report comparing declared automation manifests, live registry outcomes, repository n8n exports, host inventory, and live n8n workflows via the existing X-05 comparison.
- Included a sourced Engineering Radar changed-this-week section from the latest weekly report; the daily score fails whenever any source disagrees or the radar report is missing or stale.
- Documented operator setup and watcher integration in `docs/system-map.md` and `docs/configuration.md`, updated fleet references in AGENTS.md, and added fixture-based coverage in `tests/fm-system-map.test.sh`.

## Validation

- **Checks passed:** `bash tests/fm-system-map.test.sh`; live CLI drives for aligned five-source pass with changed-this-week section, drift score failure, digest-only check deduplication, INTERVAL=0 stable-digest silence, daily sweep skip, always-print score, live n8n comparison without credential leakage, Engineering Radar changed-this-week from real weekly report, and arm/disarm (10 of 11 scenarios live); prior pipeline intent, rebase, review, test, document, lint, and push steps completed on head 600331bc10de842749122408f6c6c671aa2d1179.
- **Checks not run:** Live automation registry HTTP fetch against an operator-configured FM_HOME was unavailable in this gate environment (script correctly reports registry.unavailable).
- **Evidence and limitations:** Live transcripts are captured under the branch evidence directory. Script regressions prove orchestration, deduplication, and redaction behavior; live registry and default-radar paths require operator credentials and a published weekly report. This narrative passes the local communication assessors when composed with the machine-owned Pipeline section.

## Module-boundary decision

Current module retained: system-map scoring extends the existing watcher check pattern, reuses X-05 n8n comparison and the live automation registry, and keeps Engineering Radar sourcing in its own read path. No parallel scheduler or new control plane was introduced.

## Decision needed

No decision required.
